$comment: This is a `CMakePresets.json` file. It defines a set of COMMON PRESETS to configure and build your project.
A `CMakePresets.json` file is INTENDED TO BE COMMITTED TO THE REPOSITORY.
It should not contain any machine or user specific configuration. `CMakeUserPresets.json` is the file for that.
For example, you should not specify the compiler path here, as it may differ from one machine to another.
Basically, this file should contain a JSON object with three arrays: `configurePresets`, `buildPresets` and `workflowPresets`.
`configurePresets`: contains presets for the CMake cache variables about DIRECTORIES IN YOUR PROJECT and other settings.
`buildPresets`: contains presets for the different build 'modes', Release, Debug, etc.
`workflowPresets`: contains presets for running a sequence of other presets back to back in one command.

configurePresets.name: default
$comment: This base preset defines the most amount of common configuration for all other presets to inherit from.
And for all members of the team.
`binaryDir`: is equivalent to the `-B` argument of the `cmake` command. It specifies where the build files will be generated.
Important `cacheVariables` that we are setting here are:
`CMAKE_C_STANDARD`: sets the C standard to be used for compiling C files.
`CMAKE_C_STANDARD_REQUIRED`: tells CMake that the specified C standard is required.
`CMAKE_C_EXTENSIONS`: tells CMake whether to allow compiler-specific extensions.
Disabling it ensures all code compiles and is supported by all members' compilers.
<CXX> in the variable would be the same but for C++ files.
`CMAKE_RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY`,
`CMAKE_LIBRARY_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY` and
`CMAKE_ARCHIVE_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY`: these variables specify where the compiled executables and libraries will be placed.
After setting all these directories, all members of the team will have the same directory structure.
`bin/` for executables
`lib/bin/` for libraries,
and `build/` for build files
THESE ARE THE DIRECTORIES THAT ARE TO BE IGNORED IN THE `.gitignore`. And we know it is safe to delete them

configurePresets.name: release
$comment: Here we are setting an 'inheritance chain' to define more presets with more specific configurations.
`CMAKE_DEBUG_POSTFIX`: is the suffix that will be added to the name of the
generated executable or library when building in Debug mode. So all presets that inherit from `debug` will have this postfix.
